#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum the integers in $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt that are strictly greater than LIMIT
# and publish that sum alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt after a bounded 60s active interval.
set -eu

WORKSPACE=${1:?workspace argument required}
LIMIT=${2:?limit argument required}
MEASURED="$WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt"
RESULT="$WORKSPACE/result.txt"

if [ ! -r "$MEASURED" ]; then
  echo "analyze: cannot read $MEASURED" >&2
  exit 1
fi

total=0
included=0
excluded=0

while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  value=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d ' \t\r')
  [ -z "$value" ] && continue
  case "$value" in
    *[!0-9-]*) echo "analyze: skipping non-integer line: $line" >&2; continue ;;
  esac
  if [ "$value" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
    total=$((total + value))
    included=$((included + 1))
  else
    excluded=$((excluded + 1))
  fi
done < "$MEASURED"

# Bounded active Job interval: the result is published only after this sleep.
sleep 60

printf '%s\n' "$total" > "$RESULT"
echo "analyze: LIMIT=$LIMIT included=$included excluded=$excluded sum=$total -> $RESULT"

#!/bin/sh
# analyze.sh WORKSPACE LIMIT
# Sum the integers in $WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt that are strictly greater than LIMIT
# and publish that sum alone to $WORKSPACE/result.txt after a bounded 60s active interval.
set -eu

WORKSPACE=${1:?workspace argument required}
LIMIT=${2:?limit argument required}
MEASURED="$WORKSPACE/flow/measured.txt"
RESULT="$WORKSPACE/result.txt"

if [ ! -r "$MEASURED" ]; then
  echo "analyze: cannot read $MEASURED" >&2
  exit 1
fi

total=0
included=0
excluded=0

while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  value=$(printf '%s' "$line" | tr -d ' \t\r')
  [ -z "$value" ] && continue
  case "$value" in
    *[!0-9-]*) echo "analyze: skipping non-integer line: $line" >&2; continue ;;
  esac
  if [ "$value" -gt "$LIMIT" ]; then
    total=$((total + value))
    included=$((included + 1))
  else
    excluded=$((excluded + 1))
  fi
done < "$MEASURED"

# Bounded active Job interval: the result is published only after this sleep.
sleep 60

printf '%s\n' "$total" > "$RESULT"
echo "analyze: LIMIT=$LIMIT included=$included excluded=$excluded sum=$total -> $RESULT"
